TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Foundation resources for the RAG rulebook staging ECS Fargate service.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: rag-rulebook-staging
  RepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: rag-rulebook-service
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
  ExistingAlbSecurityGroupId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id
  ExistingHttpsListenerArn:
    Type: String
  ExistingAlbDnsName:
    Type: String
  ExistingAlbCanonicalHostedZoneId:
    Type: String
  HostedZoneId:
    Type: String
  HostName:
    Type: String
    Default: rag.kanbien.com
  ListenerRulePriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 40
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14

Resources:
  Repository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref RepositoryName
      EmptyOnDelete: true
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Keep the last 10 staging images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "any",
                  "countType": "imageCountMoreThan",
                  "countNumber": 10
                },
                "action": {
                  "type": "expire"
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/ecs/rag-rulebook-staging
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: rag-rulebook/staging/service-token
      Description: Bearer token for the staging RAG rulebook API until Cognito auth is implemented.
      GenerateSecretString:
        PasswordLength: 48
        ExcludePunctuation: true

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: rag-rulebook-staging-task-execution
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: read-service-token-secret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref ServiceTokenSecret

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: rag-rulebook-staging-task
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow the staging ALB to reach the RAG rulebook service.
      GroupName: rag-rulebook-staging-service
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3000
          ToPort: 3000
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ExistingAlbSecurityGroupId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: rag-rulebook-staging
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Port: 3000
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /health
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: "30"

  HostRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      ListenerArn: !Ref ExistingHttpsListenerArn
      Priority: !Ref ListenerRulePriority
      Conditions:
        - Field: host-header
          HostHeaderConfig:
            Values:
              - !Ref HostName
      Actions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  DnsAlias:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZoneId
      Name: !Ref HostName
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref ExistingAlbDnsName
        HostedZoneId: !Ref ExistingAlbCanonicalHostedZoneId
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

Outputs:
  RepositoryUri:
    Value: !GetAtt Repository.RepositoryUri
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RepositoryUri
  LogGroupName:
    Value: !Ref LogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-LogGroupName
  ServiceTokenSecretArn:
    Value: !Ref ServiceTokenSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ServiceTokenSecretArn
  TaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TaskExecutionRoleArn
  TaskRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TaskRoleArn
  ServiceSecurityGroupId:
    Value: !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ServiceSecurityGroupId
  TargetGroupArn:
    Value: !Ref TargetGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TargetGroupArn
  PublicSubnetIdsCsv:
    Value: !Join [",", !Ref PublicSubnetIds]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIdsCsv
  HostName:
    Value: !Ref HostName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-HostName
